article_dinosaur_land.summary: Bảo walks into a green valley where dinosaurs still walk, and finds something small under a big leaf. Follow her past the ferns, the giant footprints and the warm nests. After reading, you can retell the journey, use five new dinosaur words in your own sentences, and explain why she left the bone in the ground.
article_dinosaur_land.title: A Journey Through Dinosaur Land

article_loneliness_selectivity.summary: Loneliness is a feeling, and being alone is a fact, and the two are easily confused. After reading this you can tell loneliness, isolation, alienation and solitude apart, explain why a standard rises and what a closed door costs, describe commitment as a series of small decisions, and say what you want from a relationship in sentences you can use.
article_loneliness_selectivity.title: Loneliness, Selectivity and Commitment
